description: This PHP file represents a migration script for updating the database schema or configuration in the OrangeHRM application. It defines the Migration class that updates default page settings for the 'time' module for the 'Admin' user role during the migration process.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: A class responsible for managing a specific database migration, specifically updating the default page for the 'time' module for the 'Admin' role in OrangeHRM version 4.1.2.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Performs the migration by updating the default page priority for the 'time' module for the 'Admin' role.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version of the migration, which is '4.1.2'.
